'''Ghorla''' were [[Equine/Legends|equinoid]] creatures that lived on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. They were ridden by hunters that were chasing prey in the [[Hanna Wild Game Reserve]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
